decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter fits the firm's strategic push into organic lines and its existing curing capabilities, and with industry turnover growing and the firm hiring, there is enough slack to carry it, though its mere mention on the website suggests lower prominence and some risk of a quiet delisting.

Organic poultry mini salami snacks sit close to the core offer, serve the growing organic and snacking segments the firm targets, and have their own page, signalling commitment, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The premium sharing salami snack builds on established salami know-how, is prominently presented, and fits the convenience trend in a growing industry, so management sees results within aspiration and keeps it.
